@hasseDeriv : {σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial σ R

def MvPolynomial.hasseDeriv.{u_1, u_2} : {σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R →ₗ[R] MvPolynomial σ R :=
fun {σ} {R} [CommSemiring R] d ↦
  ((Finsupp.lsum R) fun k ↦ monomial (k - d) ∘ₗ (LinearMap.lsmul R R) ↑(hasseCoeff d k)) ∘ₗ
    ↑(AddMonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv R)
fun d ↦ ⇑(hasseDeriv d) : (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial σ R → MvPolynomial σ R
fun d ↦ hasseDeriv d : (ℕ →₀ ℕ) → MvPolynomial ℕ ℕ →ₗ[ℕ] MvPolynomial ℕ ℕ

fun d ↦
  hasseDeriv
    d : (ULift.{1, 0} ℕ →₀ ℕ) →
  MvPolynomial (ULift.{1, 0} ℕ) (ULift.{1, 0} ℕ) →ₗ[ULift.{1, 0} ℕ] MvPolynomial (ULift.{1, 0} ℕ) (ULift.{1, 0} ℕ)

@hasseDeriv_monomial : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (d k : σ →₀ ℕ) (a : R),
  (hasseDeriv d) ((monomial k) a) = (monomial (k - d)) (↑(hasseCoeff d k) * a)
